Reference a numbered figure or table

Source: R/numbering-hook.R
oq_ref.Rd

Inline helper that inserts a Word REF field (a clickable cross-reference) to a figure or table numbered with oq_numbering(). It displays what Quarto's @fig-x would: the label and number, for example "Figure 1". Use it in inline R code: `r oq_ref("fig-x")`.

Usage

oq_ref(id)

Arguments

id

The chunk label of the figure or table, for example "fig-x".

Value

A knitr::asis_output() string (raw OpenXML for docx, @id otherwise).

Details

In an officequarto project you can usually write Quarto's @fig-x instead: the extension's refs.lua filter converts it to the same field. oq_ref() remains useful outside such a project and wherever an explicit R call is preferable.

For output formats other than docx it returns Quarto's own notation (@fig-x), which Quarto resolves natively, so the same .qmd renders correctly to HTML.

See also

oq_numbering()
